record.question: Which state hosted the Khelo India University Games 2025?
record.explanation: Answer A: Rajasthan. The 2025 Khelo India University Games were scheduled to be hosted by Rajasthan. Reference: https://pib.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
